title: Website controls
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High-fidelity desktop admin dashboard concept for Olentra Technologies, a global technology company. This is a brainstorming image, not a deployed application.
Primary request: Generate one exceptionally polished, realistic enterprise website administration dashboard image, wide landscape approximately 16:10, at high resolution, viewed straight on. Show the modules needed to manage a global company website, with prominent ON/OFF controls for public features including internships. This must be a coherent usable UI screenshot, not a poster, infographic, code sample, or device photograph.
Brand context: Company name "OLENTRA", small descriptor "Technologies". Existing brand uses near-black navy #070b12, dark slate card surfaces, vivid blue #2563EB and indigo accents, white headings and subdued silver secondary text. Elegant restrained design, clean grid, fine borders, generous spacing, crisp highly readable sans-serif typography, tasteful line icons. Functional dashboard controls, minimal glow, no decorative science-fiction effects. Use wordmark text, not a fabricated official logo.
Layout:
1. Fixed left sidebar about 15% width. Brand at top; small workspace label "Company workspace". Navigation labels, each on its own line with a clear line icon:
"Overview"
"Website Controls" [selected blue highlight]
"Content & Media"
"Careers & Internships"
"Forms & Enquiries"
"Analytics & SEO"
"Monitoring & Alerts"
"Regions & Languages"
"Team & Access"
"Approvals & Audit Log"
"Integrations"
"Settings & Backups"
At bottom a small owner avatar and role "Owner".
2. Top bar on main canvas: breadcrumb "Workspace / Website Controls", search field, notification bell, environment selector "Production", region selector "Global", and "View website" button. Small clear label "CONCEPT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA" so invented metrics cannot be mistaken for actual company data.
3. Page heading "Website control center", subtitle "Manage visibility, publishing and website health." Top right buttons "Preview changes" and blue "Review & publish".
4. Four compact summary cards in one row: "Uptime · 30 days" value "99.98%"; "Visitors · 24 hours" value "24,816"; "Open enquiries" value "42"; "Pending approvals" value "3". Tiny simple sparklines may accompany values.
5. Main working area below: a large "Feature visibility" card covering about 62% main width, and an "Internship settings" card on its right covering 38%. Feature card has filter "All features", tiny helper "Choose what visitors can see", and an orderly table with columns "Feature", "Public visibility", "Scope". Six spacious rows:
"Services" — blue ON toggle with knob right, label "Visible" — "Global"
"Products" — blue ON toggle with knob right, label "Visible" — "Global"
"Internships" — gray OFF toggle with knob left, label "Hidden" — "Global" [selected row with a subtle blue outline]
"Blog & insights" — blue ON toggle with knob right, label "Visible" — "Global"
"AI assistant" — gray OFF toggle with knob left, label "Hidden" — "Global"
"Maintenance mode" — gray OFF toggle with knob left, label "Off" — "Global"
Below table restrained controls "Schedule change" and "View history".
6. Right settings card exact heading "Internship settings". Badge "Hidden". Three distinct settings, each with clear toggle and short secondary line:
"Public page visibility" OFF, helper "Hidden from navigation and public pages"
"Accept new applications" OFF, helper "New submissions closed"
"Existing intern portal" ON, helper "Current interns keep access"
A small divider then a readable status "Direct URL: Not available". Region field "Global", brief text "Existing applications are preserved". Footer link "Preview visitor experience". This carefully distinguishes hiding public content from closing intake and existing user access.
7. Bottom row has 3 cards: "Global monitoring", "Performance", "Approvals & activity". Global monitoring includes a small subtle outline world map with calm green monitoring points and a row of three checks labelled "Americas", "Europe", "Asia Pacific"; all say "Operational". Performance has simple small line chart and three readable metric labels and sample values: "LCP 1.8 s", "INP 120 ms", "CLS 0.04". Approvals & activity has concise entries "Homepage update · Awaiting review", "Internships hidden · Owner", "Backup verified · 2 hours ago" and a small "View audit log" link.
Composition constraints: Make the switches large, instantly recognizable and in correct ON/OFF positions. All key text must be spelled correctly and readable. Sidebar must fit all twelve modules without clipping. No overlap, cropped panels, tiny illegible filler, floating windows or external annotations. No arbitrary revenue or security scores. Professional production-quality interface with a clear hierarchy; the feature control table and internship settings are the visual focal point. Opaque background, no watermark.
editPrompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit the supplied Olentra dashboard concept image with exactly one local correction in the bottom-left account area: replace the fictional personal name "Arjun Mehta" with "Company owner", and replace the photographic headshot avatar with a simple circular blue avatar containing the white letter "O". Keep the small second line "Owner". Preserve every other pixel, layout, color, word, switch, table, metric, border, icon, panel and the "CONCEPT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA" label. Do not add any other changes. Keep the original dimensions and readable text.
notes: Original concept retained as the design-system reference.
